## What's New in v1.6.1 — 100% Complete Feature Restored in Compose UI

### ⚡ 100% Feature Restoration & Clean Jetpack Compose Categorization
- **Complete Feature Access:** Restored and connected 100% of all privacy, anti-revoke, stealth, custom toolbar, theme customization, IG status, bubble colors, and chat tweak options.
- **5-Tab Navigation System:** Organised into Home, Privacy, General, Style & Customization, and Tools.
- **Stealth & Receipts:** Anti-Read (`hideread`), Anti-Delivery (`hidereceipt`), Blue on Reply (`blueonreply`), Anti-Status Read (`hidestatusview`), Anti View-Once (`viewonce`), Hide Audio Played (`hideaudioseen`).
- **Presence & Typing:** Freeze Last Seen (`freezelastseen`), Hide Typing (`ghostmode_t`), Hide Recording (`ghostmode_r`), Always Online (`always_online`).
- **Anti-Delete:** Anti-Delete Messages (`antirevoke`), Anti-Delete Status (`antirevokestatus`), Show Edited History (`antieditmessages`), Anti-Disappearing (`antidisappearing`).
- **General & Toolbar:** Ghost Mode Button (`ghostmode`), Freeze Last Seen Button (`show_freezeLastSeen`), DND Button (`show_dndmode`), Show Name/Bio (`shownamehome`/`showbiohome`), Hide Archived Chats (`typearchive`), Enhanced Locked Chats (`lockedchats_enhancer`).
- **Chat Tweaks:** Double Tap React (`doubletap2like`), Unlimited Forwarding (`removeforwardlimit`), Unlimited Pinned Chats (`pinnedlimit`), Disable Meta AI (`metaai`), Sticker Confirmation (`alertsticker`).
- **Style & Customization:** Instagram Status Stories (`igstatus`), Custom Accent & Bubble Colors (`changecolor`/`bubble_color`), Separate Groups & Chats (`separategroups`), Floating Bottom Bar (`floating_bottom_bar`).
